Bhairavastava · v1 · evening reading

Veneration

Abhinavagupta · studio chant below · 10 verses
bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande
Bhairava-Lord, refuge of the helpless — by mind become Yours, in heart I venerate.
Why would Śiva forget? — pushing GEM
He forgets because an autonomy that couldn't mis-take itself wouldn't be autonomy. The terror is what total freedom feels like from inside its own shadow.
